title: Literary Classics Before 1900
summary: Audio-first study of influential literature before 1900, from Dante and Shakespeare through major nineteenth-century European and American fiction, including Melville and Tolstoy.
assumed_background: No prior reading is needed for story lectures; critical lectures assume the narrated story or familiarity with the primary text.
Selections span medieval poetry, early modern drama and prose, Regency and Victorian fiction, Romantic Gothic narrative, mathematical satire, and French realism.
The Moby-Dick and Anna Karenina sections each narrate the complete principal plot before interpretive lectures, and name the English text or edition used for orientation.
